titlestmt.titleproper: Guide to the Avery Fisher Student Papers MC.434
titlestmt.author: Rachel Searcy

profiledesc.creation: This finding aid was produced using ArchivesSpace on 2026-08-24 20:01:23 UTC.

did.abstract: Avery Fisher (1906-1994) was an amateur violinist, an early leader in the field of high fidelity sound reproduction, founding the Philharmonic Radio Company and Fisher Electronics. Fisher was also a philanthropist, and in 1987 the Avery Fisher Center for Music and Media was established at NYU with assistance from the Avery and Janet Fisher Foundation. Fisher graduated from NYU in 1929. This collection consists of papers written by Avery Fisher as an undergraduate student at New York University.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection consists of papers written by Avery Fisher as an undergraduate student at New York University.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
